title: Epicurean BBQ Board 17.5 x 13 - Natural

Mess-Free Design: Featuring a SUPER groove that adeptly traps liquids, these boards ensure a clean transition from BBQ to table—small, medium, and large sizes capture various liquid capacities with ease.
USA-Made Craftsmanship: Meticulously crafted in the USA, these boards guarantee exceptional durability, effortless maintenance, and reliable performance for your BBQ sessions.

Heat-Resistant & Eco-Conscious: Built to withstand high temperatures, these lightweight yet durable boards are eco-friendly, long-lasting, and require minimal maintenance—ideal for hassle-free BBQ experiences.
